sources.excerpt: WAY HUGE® SMALLS™ STO OVERDRIVE Toggle menu Compare --> Register I Sign in Search Bag Search Close Products --> All Products --> --> Electronics MXR Cry Baby Way Huge Dunlop Electronics Authentic Hendrix Pedal Parts Electronic Parts Legacy Products Guitar Picks Tortex Nylon Max-Grip Jazz Herco Gator Grip Celluloid Ultex Primetone Delrin 500 Flow Finger & Thumb Stubby Variety Packs Artist Series Graphic Artist Series Pick Tins Other Clearance Accessories Capos Slides & Tonebars MXR Cables Care & Maintenance Strap Retainer Straps Tuners Pick Holders GrooveTech Tools Accu-Fret Fretwire Clearance Strings Artist Series Electric Bass Acoustic Classical Americana Ukulele Apparel Shirts Hoodies Hats Artists Lifestyle Sign in WAY HUGE® SMALLS™ STO OVERDRIVE WM25 Description *LEGACY PRODUCT / NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION   This little box offers a fast ride to overdriven paradise, delivering smooth, pillowy overdrive straight out of Nashville honky tonks. Warranty Information The Long Story The Way Huge Smalls STO delivers smooth, silky overdrive that sounds like the purr of a freshly tuned-up muscle car. The circuit that it's based on has been a special secret passed around for years among Nashville honky tonks and recording studios like a nice charcoal-filtered whiskey. Rumors surround its introduction to the scene, but any who've played it would agree on its ability to gradually butter up your tone while preserving the fundamental character of your guitar and amp. When Mr. Jeorge Tripps got hold of one, he stuck his head under the hood and tinkered for days on end without availing himself of sleep, or food, or water. Eventually, he emerged from his workshop with the STO, a reimagined version of the Nashville staple equipped with a smoother more pillowy sound. The Way Huge STO's simple three-knob setup offers just about the fastest and easiest ride to overdriven paradise. The Drive knob deserves special recognition—its range is wide and responsive and makes it sound like your amp is breaking up of its own natural accord but without any more volume than you need. Special batch run.
